ITA-5.54.1 vraṇaḥ व्रणः
Ulcer
An ulcer is an open sore on an external or internal surface of the body; caused by a break in the skin or mucous membrane which fails to heal; ranging from small; painful sores in the mouth to bedsores and serious lesions of the stomach or intestine.

ITA-5.76.233 vraṇa-apacāraḥ व्रण-अपचारः
Condition due to due to improper wound care
ITA-

.55 vraṇa-ropaṇaḥ व्रण-रोपणः
Wound-healing
ITA-

.68 vraṇa-śodhanam व्रण-शोधनम्
Wound cleansing

ITA-9.6.114 upanāhakarma (vraṇacikitsā) उपनाहकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Poultice application
Application of a poultice prepared with medications to treat inflammatory swellings or cellulitis.

ITA-9.6.116 śodhanakarma (vraṇacikitsā) शोधनकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Wound-cleansing measures
Therapeutic measures aimed at cleansing the wound and its periphery by applying medicines.

ITA-9.6.120 apatarpaṇakarma (vraṇacikitsā) अपतर्पणकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic abstinence from food for wound management
Therapeutic abstinence from food which is the foremost management strategy for wounds.

ITA-9.6.121 ālepakarma (vraṇacikitsā) आलेपकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic application Therapeutic application of medicinal pastes depending on the of medicated paste for vitiated dosha. wound management

ITA-9.6.122 pariṣekakarma (vraṇacikitsā) परिषेककर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic streaming Therapeutic pouring of medicated liquids for wound healing. of medicated liquids for wound management

ITA-9.6.123 abhyaṅgakarma (vraṇacikitsā) अभ्यङ्गकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic massage Therapeutic application of annointment and massage for for wound management wound healing.

ITA-9.6.124 Svedanakarma (vraṇacikitsā) स्वेदनकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic fomentation for wound management
Application of a poultice to enhance the wound-healing process.

ITA-9.6.129 snehapānakarma (vraṇacikitsā) स्नेहपानकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Internal oleation for wound management
Therapeutic intake of a medicated unctuous substance.

ITA-9.6.131 virecanakarma (vraṇacikitsā) विरे चनकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic purgation Therapeutic induction of purgation for wound management. for wound management

ITA-9.6.141 pīḍanakarma (vraṇacikitsā) पीडनकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Squeezing
A method of exerting pressure by applying medicines over the site or via manual pressure to remove residual or remnant pus.

ITA-9.6.145 kaṣāyaḥ (vraṇacikitsā) कषायः (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of medicated decoction for wound management
Therapeutic wound cleansing or debridement with a medicated decoction.

ITA-9.6.146 vartiḥ (vraṇacikitsā) वर्तिः (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of medicated wick for wound management
A medicated wick used for wound cleansing (debridement) and healing.

ITA-9.6.147 kalkaḥ (vraṇacikitsā) कल्कः (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of medicated paste for wound management
Topical application of medicated paste to a wound.

ITA-9.6.148 sarpiḥ (vraṇacikitsā) सर्पिः (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of medicated ghee for wound management
Topical application of medicated ghee to a wound.

ITA-9.6.149 tailam (vraṇacikitsā) तैलम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of medicated oils for wound management
Topical applicationof medicated oil to a wound.

ITA-9.6.150 rasakriyā (vraṇacikitsā) रसक्रिया (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of semisolid medicated decoction for wound management
Application of semi-solidified medicated decoction for wound healing.

ITA-9.6.151 avacūrṇanam (vraṇacikitsā) अवचूर्णनम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Topical dusting for wound management
Therapeutic dusting of medicated powder over a wound.

ITA-9.6.157 kṣārakarma (vraṇacikitsā) क्षारकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of caustics for wound management
A procedure for applying medications with caustic properties.

ITA-9.6.158 agnikarma (vraṇacikitsā) अग्निकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Thermal cauterization for wound management
A thermal treatment to promote wound healing.

ITA-9.6.159 kṛṣṇakarma (vraṇacikitsā) कृष्णकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Blackening, pigmentation- A therapeutic measure to induce pigmentation in scar tissue to inducing measures match the surrounding normal skin colour.

ITA-9.6.160 pāṇḍukarma (vraṇacikitsā) पाण्डुकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Whitening, depigmentationinducing measures
A therapeutic measure to whiten or depigment a hyperpigmented scar by application of a medicinal paste.

ITA-9.6.161 savarṇakaraṇam (vraṇacikitsā) सवर्णकरणम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Normalizing scar with skin colour
A procedure to modify scar colour so that it blends with surrounding skin.

ITA-9.6.165 bastikarma (vraṇacikitsā) बस्तिकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic enema for wound management
Anorectal administration of a medicated emulsion or unctuous substance especially for promoting healing of the wounds in the lower half of the body.

ITA-9.6.167 bandhanakarma (vraṇacikitsā) बन्धनकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Bandaging
Therapeutic bandaging for faster wound healing by softening and keeping the wound clean.

ITA-9.6.170 bṛmhaṇam (vraṇacikitsā) बृंहणम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Restorative measures
Therapeutic measures for restoring and increasing bodily tissues.

ITA-9.6.171 viṣaghnam (vraṇacikitsā) विषघ्नम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Neutralization of poisons
Therapeutic neutralization of wounds due to poisons of all kinds.

ITA-9.6.172 Śirovirecanam (vraṇacikitsā) शिरोविरे चनम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Errhine medication for nasal cleansing for wound management
Application of errhine therapy for its cleansing effect specifically for wound management.

ITA-9.6.173 Nasyam (vraṇacikitsā) नस्यम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Intranasal medication for wound management
Intranasal administration of medication specifically for wound management.

ITA-9.6.174 kavaladhāraṇam (vraṇacikitsā) कवलधारणम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic gargling for wound management
Therapeutic gargling (kavala) for removal of dosha, alleviation of pain and burning, and cleansing of oral cavity wounds.

ITA-9.6.175 dhūmaḥ/ dhūmapānam (vraṇacikitsā) धूमः/धूमपानम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic smoking for wound management
Therapeutic inhalation of medicated smoke.

ITA-9.6.176 kṣaudrasarpi (vraṇacikitsā) क्षौद्रसर्पः (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of honey and ghee for wound management
Therapeutic application of honey and ghee to a fresh wound.

ITA-9.6.177 yantram (vraṇacikitsā) यन्त्रम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Use of blunt instrument Therapeutic removal of a deeply embedded foreign body or to assist surgical morbid material from a wound using a blunt instrument. procedures for wound management

ITA-9.6.178 āhāraḥ (vraṇacikitsā) आहारः (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Dietary regime for wound management
Therapeutic dietery regimen prescribed for all patients with wounds (vraṇita).

ITA-9.6.179 rakṣāvidhānam (vraṇacikitsā) रक्षाविधानम् (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Protective measures Measures (e.g. fumigation, chanting mantra) to protect for wound management wounds from factors imperceptible to sense organs that are deleterious to wound healing and clinical outcome.

ITA-5.17.10 vraṇajanyarājayakṣmā व्रणजन्यराजयक्ष्मा
Consumption due to wounds
A disorder characterized by diminution of rakta, pain.

ITA-9.5.80 vraṇadhūpanam व्रणधूपनम्
Fumigation of ulcers and wounds
The therapeutic procedure of fumigating wounds or ulcers.

ITA-9.6.152 vraṇadhūpanam व्रणधूपनम्
Medicated fumigation for wound management
Therapeutic fumigation of a wound.

ITA-9.6.127 vraṇapācanakarma व्रणपाचनकर्म
Induction of suppuration
Various procedures that help to induce ripening or suppuration of the inflammation.

ITA-5.53.1 vraṇaśophaḥ व्रणशोफः
Pre-ulcerative inflammation
A condition characterized by widespread or nodular (localized) inflammation; regular or irregular; due to accumulation of vitiated dosha in the skin and muscles which may manifest in any part of the body. May develop independently leading to ulcer formation at a later stage or be preceded by vidradhi (abscess).

ITA-9.6.111 vraṇaśophasyasaptopkramāḥ व्रणशोफस्यसप्तोपक्रमाः
Seven therapies for management of pre-ulcerative inflammation
The seven therapeutic measures for management of an inflammatory swelling: gentle massage, bloodletting, poultice application, incision, wound cleaning, wound healing and cosmetic measures.

ITA-9.6.119 vraṇasyaṣaṣṭi-upakramāḥ व्रणस्यषष्टि-उपक्रमाः
Sixty therapeutic measures for wound management
Sixty therapeutic measures for management of wounds and ulcers.
ITA-

.56 vraṇyaḥ व्रण्यः
Substance promoting wound-healing

ITA-9.6.130 vamanakarma (vraṇacikitsā) वमनकर्म (व्रनचिकित्सा)
Therapeutic emesis for wound management
Therapeutic induction of emesis for wound management.
